lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਲ ਜਲੇ ਬਾਤੀ ਠਹਰਾਨੀ ਸੂੰਨਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tel jale baatee thaharaanee soo(n)naa ma(n)dar hoee ||1||
lines.translation: But when the oil is burnt, the wick goes out, and the mansion becomes desolate. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਬਉਰੇ ਤੁਹਿ ਘਰੀ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: re baure tuhi gharee na raakhai koee ||
lines.translation: O mad-man, no one will keep you, for even a moment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) raam naam jap soee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Meditate on the Name of that Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾ ਕੀ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਹੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਕਵਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ ਜੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaa kee maat pitaa kahu kaa ko kavan purakh kee joee ||
lines.translation: Tell me, whose mother is that, whose father is that, and which man has a wife?

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਫੂਟੇ ਕੋਊ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੂਛੈ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ghat phoote kooo baat na poochhai kaadhahu kaadhahu hoee ||2||
lines.translation: When the pitcher of the body breaks, no one cares for you at all. Everyone says, "Take him away, take him away!" ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਬੈਠੀ ਮਾਤਾ ਰੋਵੈ ਖਟੀਆ ਲੇ ਗਏ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dehuree baithee maataa rovai khateeaa le gae bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Sitting on the threshold, his mother cries, and his brothers take away the coffin.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਟ ਛਿਟਕਾਏ ਤਿਰੀਆ ਰੋਵੈ ਹੰਸੁ ਇਕੇਲਾ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: lat chhitakaae tireeaa rovai ha(n)s ikelaa jaaee ||3||
lines.translation: Taking down her hair, his wife cries out in sorrow, and the swan-soul departs all alone. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu bhai saagar kai taaee ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints, about the terrifying world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਬੰਦੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਜੁਲਮੁ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਜਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਹਟੈ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥੪॥੯॥ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ
lines.transliteration: is ba(n)de sir julam hot hai jam nahee hatai gusaaee ||4||9|| dutuke
lines.translation: This human suffers torture and the Messenger of Death will not leave him alone, O Lord of the World. ||4||9|| Dho-Thukay

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਇਕਤੁਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa sree kabeer jeeu ke chaupade ikatuke ||
lines.translation: Aasaa Of Kabeer Jee, Chau-Padhay, Ek-Thukay:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਨਕ ਸਨੰਦ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sanak sana(n)d a(n)t nahee paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Sanak and Sanand, the sons of Brahma, could not find the Lord's limits.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੜੇ ਪੜਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bed paRe paR brahame janam gavaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Brahma wasted his life away, continually reading the Vedas. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਬਿਲੋਵਨਾ ਬਿਲੋਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa bilovanaa bilovahu mere bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Churn the churn of the Lord, O my Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਬਿਲੋਵਹੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj bilovahu jaise tat na jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Churn it steadily, so that the essence, the butter, may not be lost. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਟੁਕੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਲੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan kar matukee man maahi biloee ||
lines.translation: Make your body the churning jar, and use the stick of your mind to churn it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਟੁਕੀ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੰਜੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: is matukee mahi sabad sa(n)joee ||2||
lines.translation: Gather the curds of the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਬਿਲੋਵਨਾ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa bilovanaa man kaa beechaaraa ||
lines.translation: The churning of the Lord is to reflect upon Him within your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gur prasaad paavai a(n)mrit dhaaraa ||3||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, the Ambrosial Nectar flows into us. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਮਂੀਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahu kabeer nadar kare je ma(n)eeraa ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, if the Lord, our King casts His Glance of Grace,

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਗਿ ਉਤਰੇ ਤੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam lag utare teeraa ||4||1||10||
lines.translation: one is carried across to the other side, holding fast to the Lord's Name. ||4||1||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਤੀ ਸੂਕੀ ਤੇਲੁ ਨਿਖੂਟਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: baatee sookee tel nikhootaa ||
lines.translation: The wick has dried up, and the oil is exhausted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਲੁ ਨ ਬਾਜੈ ਨਟੁ ਪੈ ਸੂਤਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)dal na baajai nat pai sootaa ||1||
lines.translation: The drum does not sound, and the actor has gone to sleep. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਧੂੰਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bujh gaee agan na nikasio dhoo(n)aa ||
lines.translation: The fire has gone out, and no smoke is produced.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਏਕੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: rav rahiaa ek avar nahee dooaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The One Lord is pervading and permeating everywhere; there is no other second. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਟੂਟੀ ਤੰਤੁ ਨ ਬਜੈ ਰਬਾਬੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tootee ta(n)t na bajai rabaab ||
lines.translation: The string has broken, and the guitar makes no sound.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੂਲਿ ਬਿਗਾਰਿਓ ਅਪਨਾ ਕਾਜੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bhool bigaario apanaa kaaj ||2||
lines.translation: He mistakenly ruins his own affairs. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਕਹਨੁ ਕਹਾਵਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kathanee badanee kahan kahaavan ||
lines.translation: When one comes to understand,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਮਝਿ ਪਰੀ ਤਉ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਗਾਵਨੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: samajh paree tau bisario gaavan ||3||
lines.translation: He forgets his preaching, ranting and raving, and arguing. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਪੰਚ ਜੋ ਚੂਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer pa(n)ch jo choore ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, the state of supreme dignity is never far

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਤੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਦੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: tin te naahi param pad doore ||4||2||11||
lines.translation: From those who conquer the five demons of the body passions. ||4||2||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਤੁ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sut aparaadh karat hai jete ||
lines.translation: As many mistakes as the son commits,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਨੀ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਰਾਖਸਿ ਤੇਤੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jananee cheet na raakhas tete ||1||
lines.translation: his mother does not hold them against him in her mind. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਈਆ ਹਉ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamaeeaa hau baarik teraa ||
lines.translation: O Lord, I am Your child.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਨ ਖੰਡਸਿ ਅਵਗਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaahe na kha(n)das avagan meraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Why not destroy my sins? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਅਤਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਪ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: je at krop kare kar dhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: If the son, in anger, runs away,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਭੀ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਰਾਖਸਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: taa bhee cheet na raakhas maaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: even then, his mother does not hold it against him in her mind. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤ ਭਵਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: chi(n)t bhavan man pario hamaaraa ||
lines.translation: My mind has fallen into the whirlpool of anxiety.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naam binaa kaise utaras paaraa ||3||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, how can I cross over to the other side? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹਿ ਬਿਮਲ ਮਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dehi bimal mat sadaa sareeraa ||
lines.translation: Please, bless my body with pure and lasting understanding, Lord;

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਗੁਨ ਰਵੈ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj sahaj gun ravai kabeeraa ||4||3||12||
lines.translation: in peace and poise, Kabeer chants the Praises of the Lord. ||4||3||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਜ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਗੋਮਤੀ ਤੀਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: haj hamaaree gomatee teer ||
lines.translation: My pilgrimage to Mecca is on the banks of the Gomati River;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹਾ ਬਸਹਿ ਪੀਤੰਬਰ ਪੀਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jahaa basahi peeta(n)bar peer ||1||
lines.translation: the spiritual teacher in his yellow robes dwells there. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਖੂਬੁ ਗਾਵਤਾ ਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu kiaa khoob gaavataa hai ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! Hail! Hail! How wondrously he sings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਤਾ ਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam merai man bhaavataa hai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord is pleasing to my mind. ||1||Pause||
